source_name: Українська асоціація фінтех та інноваційних компаній (UAFIC) — fintechua.org
why_relevant: Organiser of Ukraine Fintech Week (Pay.Forum, Digital Lending, HR-Tech committee, Ukrainian Fintech Awards) and holder of a fintech member directory. Central hub linking event agendas, sponsors and the association's own actor map.

source_name: Ukraine Fintech Week 2026 — programme page
why_relevant: The single largest UA fintech week (16-20 March 2026) aggregating Pay.Forum, Digital Lending, regulator round tables and the Fintech Awards; the agenda exposes buyer-side speakers (banks, NBU) alongside sponsoring vendors.

source_name: Ukrainian Fintech Awards — fintechawards.com.ua
why_relevant: Dedicated award site for the UAFIC fintech awards (35+ nominations). Shortlists and winner pages identify which UA fintech deployments and vendor partnerships the market considers notable — e.g. NovaPay's 2026 wins for best non-banking mobile app and best e-commerce fintech partner.

source_name: FinAwards (Мінфін + Finance.ua) — премія фінансового ринку
why_relevant: Eight-plus-year-old joint award of Minfin and Finance.ua covering 40+ nominations across banks, MFOs, insurers, investment and fintech companies, including explicit technology/innovation categories ('Провідні технології та інновації', 'Найкращий мобільний додаток'). Nominee lists are a near-complete census of consumer-facing UA financial brands and reveal which digital deployments are being marketed.

source_name: PSM Awards / PaySpace Magazine Awards (psm7.com)
why_relevant: Fintech/e-commerce/payments award running since 2016 by the PaySpace Magazine trade outlet; the most payments-specific UA award. Nomination categories map closely to payment acceptance, acquiring and card products, so shortlists surface acquirers, PSPs and terminal/software vendors.

source_name: Фінансовий клуб — рейтинг «Банки року» та галузеві форуми (Legal Banking Forum)
why_relevant: Finclub runs the 'Банки року' ranking (20+ nominations, presented at the XII Legal Banking Forum in Feb 2026) plus a stream of banking forums with published speaker lists and partners. Award methodology is NBU-reporting-based, including active payment-card count dynamics — useful as an indirect payments-volume signal, and the forums expose sponsoring vendors.

source_name: Міжнародний фінансовий клуб «BANKIR» — Banking Forum: Digital Trends / Digital Banking Ecosystem & Fintech
why_relevant: Long-running commercial organiser of UA banking IT forums (Digital Trends 2026; Digital Banking Ecosystem & Fintech, Aug 2026) spanning banking, fintech, telecom and cybersecurity. Agendas and partner blocks name the integrators and software vendors pitching cloud, AI, analytics and API work to UA banks.

source_name: American Chamber of Commerce in Ukraine — events calendar (fintech/payments)
why_relevant: AmCham co-hosts and lists Ukraine Fintech Week and the Power Payment Summit: Ukraine–Europe Bridge (10 Sep 2026, Hyatt Regency Kyiv, with IFC/World Bank and SECO). Its member base skews to international vendors, so its event pages surface foreign entrants and their local partners that UA-only media miss.

source_name: Незалежна асоціація банків України (НАБУ) — новини про галузеві премії та заходи
why_relevant: The other UA banking association; covers award ceremonies (FinAwards) and runs its own member events. Note the acronym НАБУ is heavily polluted by the anti-corruption bureau — query with 'Незалежна асоціація банків' to disambiguate.

source_name: НБУ — Форум з фінансової інклюзії (finclusion.bank.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Regulator-hosted international forum co-organised with market participants and donor partners; the sponsor/partner and speaker lists reveal which vendors and international institutions the NBU is willing to platform — a strong signal of policy-aligned commercial opportunities (cash access, digital payments inclusion).

source_name: НБУ — Дослідницька конференція (events.bank.gov.ua)
why_relevant: The NBU's dedicated events host; the annual research conference site pattern (events.bank.gov.ua/<event>/<year>/) implies other NBU event microsites live on the same host, making it a discovery root for regulator-run gatherings and their programme committees.

source_name: TradeMasterGroup — конференції та виставки (Food&NonFood Master, BIG Trade-Marketing Show, PrivateLabel, Distribution Master)
why_relevant: High-volume B2B retail/FMCG event organiser (2000+ participants at the March 2026 edition) publishing partner tiers (e.g. general partner НАША СИЛА, official partner PR GROUP) and exhibitor lists. Retail-tech and payment-acceptance vendors buy sponsorship here to reach retail buyers, so it complements the banking-side conference set.

source_name: Міжнародний виставковий центр (МВЦ / IEC Kyiv) — календар виставок
why_relevant: Kyiv's main exhibition venue; its calendar is a venue-level pointer that catches trade shows (retail, security, IT, banking equipment) whose organisers have weak web presence and would otherwise be missed by topic search.

source_name: EuroShop (Düsseldorf) exhibitor directory — UA exhibitors and UA-relevant self-service vendors
why_relevant: The world's largest retail-technology fair; UA manufacturer Modern Expo took the largest single stand (1,600 sqm) among 1,800 exhibitors at EuroShop 2026, showing self-checkout, modular store and parcel-locker lines. The exhibitor directory is an offshore pointer that reveals UA vendors' product roadmaps and their international competitor set in self-service and cash/retail automation.

source_name: DIGITALFORUM.PRO — Fintech & Payments Forum
why_relevant: B2B forum (9 April 2026, Kyiv + online) explicitly targeting banks, fintech, IT and e-commerce; smaller commercial events like this are where new market entrants buy visibility before they have press coverage.

source_name: Мінфін — проєкт FinYear та конференційні анонси
why_relevant: Minfin runs both FinYear (paid industry conference, Feb 2026) and co-owns FinAwards; its project subdomain is a single origin for agendas, speaker rosters and award nominee announcements across the UA consumer-finance market.

source_name: Digital Lending Ukraine conference (dl.fintechua.org)
why_relevant: Dedicated lending-tech conference under the UAFIC umbrella with named bank/fintech speakers (CreditWest Bank, Радабанк, Activitis) — a narrow but high-signal list of lending-platform vendors and their bank references.

source_name: paytech.events — 2026-2027 fintech, banking & payments conference calendar
why_relevant: Third-party global event aggregator; useful as a cross-check to catch UA-relevant regional (CEE) payments events that UA-language sources do not list, and to identify where UA banks/vendors appear abroad.

source_name: FinRetail conference (finretail.net)
why_relevant: Annual UA conference sitting exactly on the fintech/retail boundary (AI innovation, retail and financial sector) — the intersection where payment-acceptance, self-service and in-store banking vendors sell.

source_name: Bank award-page aggregations on vendor/bank sites (e.g. OTP Bank «Нагороди банку, премії та номінації», NovaPay awards posts)
why_relevant: Banks and PSPs maintain running award pages that back-fill shortlist/winner history when the award organiser's own archive is thin or has rotated URLs. They also state the exact nomination wording, which is often the only public description of the underlying deployment.
